text:
maya: Hey design team — need a small launch pack for next week's benchmark release. 3 hero images (web/email/social), a diagram for the webinar slide, and an 'inbound kit' for SDRs. Can we also get variant copy for A/B testing? Need legal signoff before go.
eli: Got it. What's the target audience / POV? Are these benchmark visuals audience-facing (technical) or more executive? :thinking_face:
maya: Audience is product/platform engineers + platform buyers. Want a technical hero + a simplified 'why it matters' tile for execs. Also include a smaller social tile for webinar promo.
zoe: Also need 2 headline variants and 2 CTAs per asset for A/B. Example CTAs: "See the benchmark" / "Compare performance". We'll add UTM params for inbound routing.
sam: Webinar deck needs the diagram by Tue EOD. Also need a 1-slide one-pager we can hand to sales with link buttons -> sends to /demo?utm=bench_launch
eli: Quick spec — I'll produce: 1200x628 (social), 1200x1200 (square), 1600x900 (hero); plus a 800x600 webinar diagram export. Colors + type per brand kit. Will attach Figma link when ready. ```image-specs:
- social: 1200x628
- square: 1200x1200
- hero: 1600x900
- diagram: 800x600
format: PNG + SVG source
``` 
designbot: Figma file created: https://figma.com/file/rdw-launch-benchpack (permissions: design-team)
eli: Planning to deliver initial drafts by Mon morning, final assets Tue after legal OK. Will include layered SVGs and an HTML email slice for the inbound kit.
tess: Legal here — quick checks:
- Claims around "50% lower cost" need dataset/source citation
- Can't use competitor logos in imagery without approval
- Need trademark vet for new phrase "Inference Economy"
Please add citations for benchmark numbers and give me the exact copy for the headlines.
maya: Noted. I'll paste the benchmark callout and methodology snippet below by EOD. Also include localization for EN/FR/DE — at least copy csv for translations.
zoe: For routing: SDR form should pick variant via ?utm_content=varA or varB. Can design export include a small copy CSV mapping headline->variant? :thumbsup:
eli: Yes — will include CSV with 2 headline columns and CTA column. Also small alt-text doc for accessibility.
maya: Accessibility QA: ensure color contrast >4.5:1 for body text and alt tags on images. Also add keyboard focus styles to the HTML slice.
sam: FYI ops: We'll need the inbound routing playbook updated: where leads go (SDR queue A/B), how to tag in SFDC. Zoe can you confirm?
zoe: Confirmed — SDR-A gets varA, SDR-B gets varB, both tagged with campaign:benchexport23. I'll update playbook once we have final asset filenames.
eli: Ok locking timeline: drafts Mon 09:00, legal review Mon 16:00, final Tue 10:00. Ping me in this thread for any copy changes. :eyes:
maya: Thanks everyone — huge help. If legal needs samples before Monday, tell me and I'll prioritize. :pray:
